name: Tonari no Bijin Tsuma wa Yokkyuu Fuman Deshita ~Aa, Ano Hito no Yori Danzen Ookikute Katai....!~
original_name: 隣の美人妻は欲求不満でした ～あぁ、あの人のより断然大きくて硬いっ…！～
source:
When I entered college, I moved to the city.
In the morning, I opened the door to take out the trash.

"......Oh, Yuuto-kun. Good morning."

A married woman who lived next door――I exchanged greetings with Kagatsuka Shiho.

Loose shoulder-length hair.
A cute and beautiful woman with nice figure.
I mean, after all, you could see it from her clothes, a nice hourglass-shape body line.
If a man were to walk pass Shiho-san in the city, he would surely want to look at such beauty.
Exactly the embodiment of the men's ideal image of a woman.

(I could not believe that someone is married to this woman, what did her husband do in his previous life?)

One day......
I saw her――Shiho-san and an unfamiliar man, entering a love hotel――.

[Translated and edited from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1256268]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
当我进入大学时，我搬到了城市。
早上，我打开门倒垃圾。

“……啊，勇斗君。早上好。”

住在隔壁的已婚妇女——我和神冢志帆寒暄了一番。

宽松的及肩长发。
一个可爱美丽，身材姣好的女人。
我的意思是，毕竟，你可以从她的衣服上看到这一点，漂亮的沙漏形身体线条。
如果一个男人在城市里路过志保先生身边，一定会想看看这样的美景。
正是男人心目中理想女人形象的体现。

（不敢相信这个女人竟然有人结婚了，她老公前世是做什么的？）有一天……
我看见她——志保同学和一个陌生的男人，走进了一家情人旅馆——。

[翻译和编辑自 [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1256268]Getchu[/url]]
